name: PIVD
simple_explanation: A slipped disc where the soft cushion between the bones of the spine bulges and presses on nearby nerves.

name: CANAL STENOSIS
simple_explanation: The spinal canal has become narrow, which can compress nerves and cause back or leg pain.

name: SCIATICA
simple_explanation: Pain caused by irritation of the sciatic nerve, often travelling from the lower back down the leg.
